page0.text:
"Ugh... I have a bad feeling about this, but I don't have a choice if that's your condition. I'll do what you want."
I convince myself to say yes, even if it's heartbreaking.

page1.text:
I give her my answer...
Is it just me, or does Tohsaka look displeased?

page2.text:
"What, Tohsaka? Was that the wrong answer?"
"No. You gave the ideal answer, even if it's a little lacking. We'll go ahead with that, since you agree.
I'm going to cast a spell on you, then. It'll make your words true."

page3.text:
"Huh? Make my words true?"
"A Geass—a magical compulsion. It's one of the strongest curses there are, and not to be used lightly.
With your consent, even I can secure this agreement."

page4.text:
"A curse of compulsion...like a Servant's Command Spell?"
"Yeah, but less versatile.
It's more like restriction of movement, and I can't force you to give up your life. I'll make it last until the end of the Holy Grail War. You don't have a problem with that, do you?"

page5.text:
"Uh...sure, that's fine."
"Then close your eyes and don't move for a bit. Don't activate your Magic Circuits, either."

page7.text:
A fire lights up in my very core.
Tohsaka's chant permeates not just my body but my heart, intertwining with my nerves.

page8.text:
I hear a sound like a bottle shaking.
Next to my heart,
a smaller heart comes into being.

page9.text:
The bell rings to announce the end of lunch time.
Lunch went by in a flash. Tohsaka's magecraft must have had me in a trance.

page11.text:
"Let's meet up at the front gate after school, then.
I'm going to have you do club activities at my house for the time being."
"Um. Club activities? At your house?"

page12.text:
"Yeah. Since we're teaming up, I should teach you to be able to fight on your own as much as I can, right?
...I already know you're an amateur since the other night, though, so we'll need to have you come over multiple days."

page13.text:
"I don't mind. I'd appreciate that, actually.
Um, are we starting today?"

page14.text:
"Obviously. We need to gauge your abilities first, then figure out how to proceed from tonight.
You'll be getting home pretty late, but that's fine since you live alone anyway, right?"
"Huh? Oh, right."

page15.text:
Tohsaka leaves with a casual wave.
A chime announces the end of lunch.
Today's Friday. Classes run until sixth period, and we get out after 3:00 PM.

page17.text:
"...Oh, man. I told Sakura I'd come home early, but I can't just cancel on Tohsaka the very first day."
I'm sorry to Sakura who I'm taking care of at home, but I'll need to join Tohsaka today.

page18.text:
...Well, Tohsaka isn't a monster.
If I explain Sakura's situation, then there's a chance she'll let me go home early just for today... Yeah. I'm pretty sure she will.
